messages.subject: S5 done: EOL/BOM seams fixed
messages.body: Fixed F1-F4 on branch fleet/build-s5 (head 47ef84f): EOL is the file's first CRLF/CR/LF terminator, lines split only on those three, a leading BOM is preserved at byte 0 and ignored for parsing, and TOC indent is relative to the shallowest included heading. Wrote 15 red-first guard tests in tests/test_seams.py and the full suite passes via python3 -m unittest discover (110 tests OK); existing LF/CRLF tests pass unchanged. Not run: ruff (not installed here); nothing pushed, SPEC.md untouched, known limits left alone.
